rules.title: Area-based baseline
rules.logic: Area-based baseline is set using a performance benchmark derived from representative control plots under Appendix 1.

rules.title: Census zero baseline
rules.logic: Where census criteria are met, absence of ARR without project intervention may be assumed and the crediting baseline is zero.

rules.title: Additionality method by approach
rules.logic: Area-based projects use a performance method and census-based projects use a project method to demonstrate additionality.

rules.title: Area-based additionality demonstrations
rules.logic: Area-based projects must demonstrate regulatory surplus, performance benchmark and investment analysis, except the investment-analysis exception where no non-carbon revenue or financial incentive exists.

rules.title: Census additionality demonstrations
rules.logic: Census-based projects must demonstrate regulatory surplus, investment analysis and common practice; investment analysis is always required.

rules.title: Regulatory surplus dependency
rules.logic: Regulatory surplus must follow the most recent VCS Methodology Requirements.

rules.title: Performance benchmark additionality
rules.logic: Area-based projects establish the Appendix 1 benchmark; validation uses an ex-ante expected difference and each verification reassesses additionality using the Appendix 1 Z test.

rules.title: Investment analysis dependency
rules.logic: Investment analysis must use benchmark or investment-comparison analysis and Step 3 of the most recent VT0008 Additionality Assessment.

rules.title: Common-practice procedure
rules.logic: Census common-practice analysis must define activity, domain and adopter class, identify essential distinctions, survey representative similar landowners within five years of start, and calculate adoption without carbon finance.

rules.title: Common-practice threshold
rules.logic: Adoption below 15% is not common practice; adoption equal to or above 15% is common practice and the activity is not additional.

rules.title: Alternative common-practice evidence
rules.logic: Public government data, peer-reviewed literature or independent industry research collected within five years of start may substitute for survey evidence when relevant and conservatively non-discriminating regarding carbon finance.
